author: Copilot
body: The build environment no longer sets VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY / VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST. Operationally, this means the deployed frontend will default to PostHog disabled unless those values are supplied via the build environment (or another build-time config mechanism). Please confirm that’s intended for all environments, since Vite env vars can’t be injected at runtime after assets are built.
